market_summary.text: It is the weekend, so stock markets are closed and crypto was quiet. Bitcoin was about 118,290 CAD on Kraken, up 0.4% in 24 hours (CoinGecko). Solana was about 156.78 CAD (+0.2%) and Ether about 3,576 CAD (+0.6%). The week's news leaned negative: Bitcoin and Ether ETF money kept leaving, and analysts expect Bitcoin to stay in a range for the rest of the year. Stock prices could not be refreshed this run because the stock data collector crashed.
